items.sentence: On [MASK], Complainant filed a formal EEO complaint claiming she was subjected to ongoing harassment based on her race (“White”) 2 when, in and around February 2022, her first- line supervisor (Supervisor) (African American) made racial slurs and threatened to physically assault her and when she informed management officials, they did nothing. 3 The Agency accepted the complaint and conducted an investigation into its claims.
During the investigation, Complainant stated that in late January/early [MASK], she was told by Supervisor not to clock out for lunch due to overtime.

She avers when she asked Supervisor if he would input her hours into the computer, he responded, "I'll slap the shit out of you." She stated later, when she asked if she could take her break, Supervisor responded, "people shouldn't be allowed breaks, Black people used to be slaves." On [MASK], Complainant claimed that when she asked Supervisor for clarification of instructions he had given her, he responded, "I'll slap the shit out of you if you don't catch on." On February 5, 2022, she said that when she told Supervisor that a package that was too heavy to lift, he responded she was, "full of shit.
You can't lift that?" On [MASK], after she was instructed to bring the wagons around, she claims Supervisor said, "You need to do it because you're White...".
On [MASK], Complainant said she said "huh?" when she did not hear what Supervisor had said and he responded, 'What do you mean huh?
